gitleaks.trigger: new-project, commit, release, or secret-sensitive files

osv.trigger: dependency manifest or lockfile changes; full/release

notes: OSV-Scanner is disabled because this static prototype declares no dependencies and has no supported lockfile.
Semgrep is enabled because the local server now accepts input and proxies an external API.
Interactive browser and 390px responsive smoke checks are performed manually because the project intentionally has no browser-test dependency.
